title: Typical periodic optimization for dynamical systems: symbolic dynamics
summary: We develop a new theory of maximizing sets in dynamical systems, for the study of ergodic optimization in systems with weak hyperbolicity but where the Mañé cohomology lemma does not hold. This leads to new solutions of the Typical Periodic Optimization problem in the Lipschitz category: existence of an open dense set of Lipschitz functions such that each member has a unique maximizing measure and this measure is periodic (an equi-distribution on a single periodic orbit).
